about: Claude Code 2.1.312, claude-haiku-5-5, the office's own harness (claudeCode().start), run twice on a new session and resumed twice, 13 Nov 2026. Each row is one request, read from the session transcript: the usage Claude Code recorded and the API's own diagnostics.cache_miss_reason. 'before' names a fresh random scratch folder in every desk's appended prompt (worklings-desk-XXXXXX\scratch), 'after' keeps the folder's name for the person (HarnessPlan.stable). The tools (16.8k tokens) come before the system prompt, so a changed prompt still reads them from the cache and rewrites everything after.
cacheTtl: 1h (every cache write was ephemeral_1h; a desk left open 5.5 minutes read its whole prefix again)
